steps.content:
You should buy from **Seller A - Brackmoor Sound**.

https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/v7fyau/a

On paper the two listings are identical:

* **Same product:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones
* **Same price:** $129.00
* **Same rating:** 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* **Same shipping:** In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days
* **Same returns:** 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.
* **Same specs listed**

The difference is honesty about warranty / authorized status:

**Seller B - Ottervale Audio**
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/v7fyau/b
claims:

> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

**Seller A - Brackmoor Sound** does not make that claim.

I checked Quellwyn's list of authorized dealers:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/v7fyau/dealers

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

Neither Brackmoor Sound nor Ottervale Audio is on that list.

That means Ottervale Audio's claim to be an Authorized Quellwyn dealer with Full manufacturer warranty is **false**. A seller willing to lie about authorized status is not trustworthy to buy from.

Brackmoor Sound doesn't make that false claim.

Important caveat: Since **neither** is authorized, per Quellwyn you would **not** get a full manufacturer warranty from either one, despite both listings saying "1-year limited warranty." If warranty matters to you, don't buy from either - buy from Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics instead.
